================================================================================
dynamic block basic
================================================================================

resource "aws_security_group" "example" {
  dynamic "ingress" {
    for_each = var.ingress_rules
    content {
      port = ingress.value.port
    }
  }
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (resource_block
    type: (string_lit)
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (block
        type: (identifier)
        label: (string_lit)
        body: (block_body
          (attribute
            name: (identifier)
            value: (expression
              (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier)))
              (get_attr
                name: (identifier))))
          (block
            type: (identifier)
            body: (block_body
              (attribute
                name: (identifier)
                value: (expression
                  (expression
                    (expression
                      (variable_expr
                        (identifier)))
                    (get_attr
                      name: (identifier)))
                  (get_attr
                    name: (identifier)))))))))))

================================================================================
dynamic block with iterator
================================================================================

resource "aws_security_group" "example" {
  dynamic "ingress" {
    for_each = var.ingress_rules
    iterator = rule
    content {
      port = rule.value
    }
  }
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (resource_block
    type: (string_lit)
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (block
        type: (identifier)
        label: (string_lit)
        body: (block_body
          (attribute
            name: (identifier)
            value: (expression
              (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier)))
              (get_attr
                name: (identifier))))
          (attribute
            name: (identifier)
            value: (expression
              (variable_expr
                (identifier))))
          (block
            type: (identifier)
            body: (block_body
              (attribute
                name: (identifier)
                value: (expression
                  (expression
                    (variable_expr
                      (identifier)))
                  (get_attr
                    name: (identifier)))))))))))
